catalog.method: GET fixed URL with header User-Agent: Fat Tunnel Lite; Base64 -> salt[16] || nonce[12] || ciphertext || tag -> Argon2id (t=3, m=8192 KiB, p=1, 32 B) -> AES-256-GCM (AAD=salt) -> JSON UTF-8
catalog.notes: Without the User-Agent the endpoint answers 404. Server ignores Range and sends chunked responses; script uses http.client with Connection: keep-alive (urllib Connection: close always truncates). Two format passwords (current + legacy); decode() tries current first, then legacy. One decryption takes ~15-20 s (Argon2id). No own URI scheme; only standard v2rayng:// install-config/install-sub.

dependencies: Python >=3.10; standard library only (pure-Python Argon2id + AES-256-GCM included in the scripts)

files.method: one-line Base64 -> same Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope as the catalog (current password, legacy fallback) -> JSON of one Networks profile
files.notes: Both passwords verified against real app payloads (embedded asset + live catalog); synthetic .fat round-trip 5/5 current, 5/5 legacy, 5/5 plain JSON. No real exported .fat yet. No .sks references in the app.

name: Fat Tunnel Lite
